schema.name: ruler
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE ruler (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, shard TEXT NOT NULL, registered_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, shard)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: tenant_shards
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE tenant_shards (tenant TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, shards INTEGER NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: viz_schema
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE viz_schema (one INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (one = 1), component TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, compat INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
